title: Packages and releases: Semantic Release publishing @anthusai/papyrus (npm) and papyrus-newsroom (PyPI) with trusted publishing
description:
## Goal
Publish `@anthusai/papyrus` (npm) and `papyrus-newsroom` (PyPI) from the Papyrus repo in lockstep with Semantic Release, from GitHub Actions, using npm and PyPI trusted publishing (OIDC). No `NPM_TOKEN`/`PYPI_TOKEN` anywhere. Push to `develop` publishes `X.Y.Z-next.N` (npm dist-tag `next`; PyPI `X.Y.Z.devN`); push to `main` publishes the stable version. Everything else in Phase 2 consumes these packages, so this lands first.

## Context (verified against origin/develop a10609d)
- The package assembly already exists from the spike (PPY-82be6c, PR #100): `packages/stage.mjs` (`node packages/stage.mjs --version <semver>` stages `@anthusai/papyrus` from `packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs` + `packages/papyrus/package.template.json`, packs `dist-packages/anthusai-papyrus-<v>.tgz`, stamps the version into a COPY of `pyproject.toml` with `pep440()` (`1.2.0-next.3` -> `1.2.0.dev3`), builds the wheel+sdist with `python -m build`). The backend entry already ships compiled JS (`src/backend.js`, `amplify/**/*.js`, `lib/define-site.js`); this ticket keeps a regression check for it.
- `pyproject.toml`: name `papyrus-newsroom`, `requires-python >=3.12,<3.14`, base deps PyYAML, citeproc-py, limatus; extras `markus` (anthus-markus >=0.5.1), `newsroom` (boto3, markitdown, tiktoken, tactus >=0.52,<1). No `file://` deps remain (verify).
- The only workflow today is `.github/workflows/inbound-email-tests.yml`. No Semantic Release config exists. Repo `AnthusAI/Papyrus` is PUBLIC (provenance works). Names are free (2026-10-05: `npm view @anthusai/papyrus` 404; `https://pypi.org/pypi/papyrus-newsroom/json` 404). Ryan owns the npm org `anthusai`.
- Packaging bug to fix here: `src/papyrus_content/cli.py` line 200 does `from publications.threat_intelligence.videoml.videos_commands import videos_attach, videos_render, videos_seed` at import time, but `publications/` is not in the wheel (`pyproject.toml` `[tool.poetry] packages`), so the installed `papyrus` CLI cannot even import. (VID1 later moves the module into `papyrus_content`.)
- AGENTS.md: agents never merge to `main`; Git Flow with `develop` as integration.

## Exact changes
1. `release.config.cjs` (new, repo root):
   ```js
   module.exports = {
     branches: ["main", { name: "develop", prerelease: "next", channel: "next" }],
     plugins: [
       ["@semantic-release/commit-analyzer", { preset: "conventionalcommits" }],
       ["@semantic-release/release-notes-generator", { preset: "conventionalcommits" }],
       ["@semantic-release/exec", {
         prepareCmd: "node packages/stage.mjs --version ${nextRelease.version} && node packages/verify-packages.mjs ${nextRelease.version}",
         publishCmd: "npm publish dist-packages/anthusai-papyrus-${nextRelease.version}.tgz --access public --provenance --tag ${nextRelease.channel || 'latest'}",
         successCmd: "echo \"published=true\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\" && echo \"version=${nextRelease.version}\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\""
       }],
       "@semantic-release/github"
     ]
   };
   ```
   No `@semantic-release/git` and no `@semantic-release/npm`: versions are stamped into the staged copies only, never committed back (protected branches, no bot pushes).
2. Root `package.json` devDependencies (+ lockfile): `semantic-release@^25`, `conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits`, `@semantic-release/exec`, `@semantic-release/github`. Add script `"release:dry-run": "semantic-release --dry-run --no-ci"`.
3. `.github/workflows/release.yml` (new). Trigger `push` on `main`, `develop`. `concurrency: { group: release-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: false }`. Workflow `permissions: {}`; per job:
   - `smoke`: `uses: ./.github/workflows/package-smoke.yml`.
   - `release` (`needs: smoke`; permissions `contents: write, issues: write, pull-requests: write, id-token: write`): `actions/checkout@v4` (`fetch-depth: 0`, `persist-credentials: false`), `actions/setup-node@v4` (node 22), `npm install -g npm@^11.5.1` (trusted publishing needs npm >= 11.5.1), `actions/setup-python@v5` (3.12) + `pip install build`, `npm ci`, `npx semantic-release` with env `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (the per-run ephemeral token, not a stored secret). Outputs `published`, `version` (from `successCmd`). When published: `actions/upload-artifact@v4` name `python-dist`, path `dist-packages/*.whl` and `dist-packages/*.tar.gz` (the sdist; make sure no other .tar.gz is in that folder).
   - `pypi` (`needs: release`, `if: needs.release.outputs.published == 'true'`, permissions `id-token: write, contents: read`): `actions/download-artifact@v4` into `dist/`, then `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1` with `packages-dir: dist/`. (Trusted publishing, attestations on by default.)
4. `.github/workflows/package-smoke.yml` (new; triggers `workflow_call` and `pull_request` for paths `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `amplify/**`, `app/**`, `components/**`, `renderers/**`, `src/**`, `pyproject.toml`, `package.json`, `release.config.cjs`): checkout, node 22, python 3.12, `pip install build`, `npm ci`, `node packages/stage.mjs --version 0.0.0-smoke.1`, `node packages/verify-packages.mjs 0.0.0-smoke.1`.
5. `packages/verify-packages.mjs` (new; Node, no deps; `node packages/verify-packages.mjs <semver>`; exits 1 with a message on the first failed check). Checks, using `dist-packages/`:
   - tarball exists; `tar -tzf` lists `package/src/backend.js`, `package/amplify/site-backend.js`, `package/lib/define-site.js`, `package/routes.manifest.json`, `package/infra/index.js` (regression for spike finding 1: Node refuses to type-strip `.ts` under `node_modules`);
   - tarball `package.json` version == `<semver>`, `peerDependenciesMeta` marks `aws-cdk-lib` and `constructs` optional, and `dependencies` has neither;
   - wheel exists named `papyrus_newsroom-<pep440(semver)>-py3-none-any.whl`; its `METADATA` has no `Requires-Dist` containing `@ file:` or `git+`;
   - consumer simulation in a temp dir: `npm init -y`; `npm install <tgz> next@15 react@19 react-dom@19`; `npm ls aws-cdk-lib constructs` reports nothing installed; then repeat with a second tarball version (`--version 0.0.0-smoke.2`) via `npm install <tgz2>` and run `npm ci --dry-run` (spike finding 4: an incrementally updated lock failed `npm ci`; this check fails the build if it recurs);
   - Python: `python -m venv` temp venv; `pip install dist-packages/*.whl`; `python -c "import papyrus_content.cli"` succeeds; `papyrus content list articles` exits non-zero WITHOUT an `ImportError`/`ModuleNotFoundError` in stderr (it should say the GraphQL endpoint is missing); `pip show -f papyrus-newsroom` lists no `publications/` path.
6. `src/papyrus_content/cli.py`: delete the top-level import at line 200 and import `videos_attach, videos_render, videos_seed` inside the `videos:*` branches of `dispatch()` (lazy). `publications/` stays unpackaged. (VID1 replaces the import path.)
7. `package.template.json`: add `"repository": { "type": "git", "url": "git+https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus.git" }` (npm provenance verification requires it to match the repo), `"homepage"`, `"keywords"`. `pyproject.toml`: add `license = "MIT"`, `[project.urls]` (Homepage, Repository), keep version `0.1.0` (stamped at build); add `Pillow >=10,<12` to the `markus` extra (the Markus image pipeline needs it and no extra declares it today; `amplify.yml` files of the readers install it by hand).
8. `docs/releasing.md` (new, short): how releases are cut (conventional commits; develop = `next` prereleases; main = stable; agents never merge to main), how a publication tries a prerelease (`npm i @anthusai/papyrus@next`, `pip install --pre papyrus-newsroom`), and the one-time registry setup below verbatim.

## Data shapes
Version mapping: `1.2.0-next.3` (npm, `--tag next`) <-> `1.2.0.dev3` (PyPI). Both packages always carry the same release number. Decision (not a question for Ryan): let Semantic Release choose the first version (it starts at `1.0.0-next.1` on develop / `1.0.0` on main); do not hand-tag.

## Tests
- Unit: `packages/verify-packages.mjs` is itself the test; also add `scripts/test-verify-packages.mjs` that feeds it a deliberately broken staging dir (missing `src/backend.js`; wheel METADATA containing `Requires-Dist: tactus @ file:///x`) and asserts exit 1 for each.
- No Gherkin (release tooling; not a behavior of the product).

## Acceptance checks
1. `node packages/stage.mjs --version 0.0.0-smoke.1 && node packages/verify-packages.mjs 0.0.0-smoke.1` exits 0 and prints one line per check.
2. `node scripts/test-verify-packages.mjs` exits 0.
3. In a throwaway checkout of `origin/develop` with this branch merged locally: `GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) npm run release:dry-run` prints "The next release version is 1.0.0-next.1" (or higher) and a notes preview, and publishes nothing.
4. After Ryan's registry setup (below) and merge to `develop`: the `Release` workflow is green; `npm view @anthusai/papyrus dist-tags --json` shows `next`; `npm view @anthusai/papyrus@<v> --json | jq .dist.attestations` is non-null (provenance); `curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/papyrus-newsroom/json | jq -r '.info.version'` shows the `.devN` version; `gh secret list -R AnthusAI/Papyrus` shows no NPM/PYPI token.
5. Fresh venv: `pip install --pre "papyrus-newsroom[markus]"` then `papyrus content list articles` fails with the missing-endpoint message, not an ImportError.

## Dependencies
None (first ticket). Blocks INF, OIC (publication repos need the packages) and, softly, every ticket whose result is consumed by a publication repo. `PPY-302a5f` is independent (it owns `tests.yml`; this ticket owns `release.yml`, `package-smoke.yml`).

## Risks
- Trusted publishing from `npm publish <tarball> --provenance` (rather than directory) is expected to work with npm >= 11.5.1 but verify on the first develop release; fallback is `npm publish` from the staged directory `dist-packages/stage-papyrus`.
- npm cannot attach a trusted publisher to a package that does not exist yet, hence the one-time placeholder publish by Ryan. A `0.0.0` placeholder is the `latest` tag until the first `main` release; this is harmless (`next` carries prereleases).
- Semantic Release prerelease branches may refuse to release `develop` until `main` has a release. If the first run says "no release on main", ask Ryan to run one `develop -> main` PR (agents never do it).
- `develop` prereleases publish automatically on every merge; breaking changes in conventional commits bump the major number. Keep `feat!`/`BREAKING CHANGE` for real breaks.
- GitHub rulesets could block the release job from creating tags; check Settings -> Rules.

## Needs Ryan (one-time, by hand; field values are authoritative, labels may shift slightly)
npm (https://www.npmjs.com):
1. Sign in as an Owner of the `anthusai` organization (avatar menu -> Organizations -> `anthusai` -> confirm your role is Owner).
2. Create the package once so a trusted publisher can be attached. In a terminal: `npm login` (browser + OTP), then
   ```
   mkdir /tmp/papyrus-bootstrap && cd /tmp/papyrus-bootstrap
   printf '{"name":"@anthusai/papyrus","version":"0.0.0","description":"Placeholder; releases are published by GitHub Actions.","license":"MIT","repository":{"type":"git","url":"git+https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus.git"}}' > package.json
   npm publish --access public      # enter the OTP when asked
   ```
3. Open https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anthusai/papyrus -> **Settings** tab -> **Trusted Publisher** section -> choose **GitHub Actions** -> Organization or user `AnthusAI`, Repository `Papyrus`, Workflow filename `release.yml`, Environment name leave EMPTY -> **Set up connection**.
4. Same Settings page -> **Publishing access** -> select **Require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens** -> **Update Package Settings**.
PyPI (https://pypi.org):
1. Sign in (enable 2FA if not already: Account settings -> Two factor authentication).
2. Go to https://pypi.org/manage/account/publishing/ (Account settings -> **Publishing**). Under **Add a new pending publisher**, GitHub tab: PyPI Project Name `papyrus-newsroom`, Owner `AnthusAI`, Repository name `Papyrus`, Workflow name `release.yml`, Environment name leave EMPTY -> **Add**. No placeholder publish is needed; the first release creates the project and the publisher becomes active.
3. After the first release, open the project -> **Manage** -> **Publishing** and confirm the GitHub publisher is listed.
GitHub: Settings -> Rules/Branches: confirm `develop`/`main` rules allow GitHub Actions to create `v*` tags and releases (semantic-release pushes tags only, no commits).
Also before merging this ticket, say yes or no to publishing a public `@anthusai/papyrus` (decided 2026-10-05: public, MIT).

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-78e818-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).

comments.text: 2026-10-05 later: OIDC exchange OK but npm PUT 403 'OIDC permission denied for this action' even after Publishing access was loosened. Likely cause (matches pbiplint/pbiplint PR #24): trusted publishers created after 2026-09-03 get 'npm stage publish' permission only; direct publish needs the separate 'Allowed actions' tick on the trusted publisher entry. Ryan to enable it on npmjs.com; then PUBLISH_ENABLED=true and re-run. PUBLISH_ENABLED currently false; orphan tag deleted again.
